title: Slice restriction commutes with total derived inverse limit of strict towers
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the universe of [def-weil-size-convention], $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $U$ an object of $\mathcal C$. Put $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ and $\mathcal A_U=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O|_U)$ on the slice site $\mathcal C/U$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let $j_U^*:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A_U$ be restriction and let $j_U^{*,\operatorname{Tow}}$ apply it levelwise to $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A)$, with levelwise exactness. Both restrictions induce termwise functors on unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $L_{\mathcal A}$ and $L_{\mathcal A_U}$ for total right derived inverse limit, computed by a K-injective resolution of strict towers followed by termwise inverse limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$j_U^*L_{\mathcal A}(X)\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{\mathcal A_U}(j_U^{*,\operatorname{Tow}}X)$$
for every $X\in D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A))$. It is the derived comparison induced by the underived restriction/limit comparison and commutes with each tower projection. In particular it identifies the derived limit of the multiplication-by-$a$ tower of any $H\in D(\mathcal A)$, restricted to $U$, with the derived limit of the multiplication-by-$a|_U$ tower of $H|_U$, for every global section $a$ of $\mathcal O$.
